turns.utterance: Apply a thin even coat of engineer's blue to a clean test arbor with the correct taper angle. ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin even coat of engineer's blue to a clean test arbor with the correct taper angle for this spindle. Insert the arbor, rotate by hand under moderate axial load, then withdraw and inspect the contact pattern. The blue should transfer uniformly over at least 70% of the taper length; a spotted or narrow band pattern indicates taper bore damage or swarf contamination.
